author: Traditionally Daniel
authorNote: Many scholars date the book in its final form to c. 165 BC, during persecution under Antiochus IV; others defend a 6th-century date.
overview: Daniel and his friends stay faithful to God in the Babylonian court, surviving the fiery furnace and the lions' den. The second half contains visions of kingdoms rising and falling, and of "one like a son of man" receiving an everlasting kingdom.
storyPlace: Set during the exile. In Christian Bibles it is among the prophets; in the Hebrew Bible it is among the Writings.
